CheckRunCompleted.description: A check run completed on a pull request's head commit, once per pull request.

app.description: The slug of the GitHub App that ran the check.

base_branch.description: The branch the pull request merges into.

baseline.description: True when the event came from the first poll of its stream.

failing.description:
Check runs on the same commit completed with a conclusion other than success, neutral or
skipped, leaving out superseded ones and a cancelled run that `superseded_by` passed.

head_branch.description: The head branch; null when GitHub no longer returns the pull request.

head_repo.description:
The head branch's repository, `owner/name`, which differs from `repo` for a fork; absent
when the event does not say, as for a check run or a deleted fork.

head_sha.description: The head commit; for a check, the commit it ran on.

name.description: The check run's name, as branch protection names a required check.

origin.description:
What started the run: `workflow:<id>:<event>` for a GitHub Actions workflow, with `:<branch>`
on a merge commit, or else `suite:<id>`, its check suite, or else `run:<id>`. A run with a
higher id of the same app, name and origin on the same commit supersedes it, unless it is
skipped or neutral and this one is not. Absent from an older intake's event.

pending.description:
Check runs on the same commit not completed at the poll, counting those past the first 100
and leaving out superseded ones.

superseded_by.description:
For a cancelled run on a merge commit: the later commit of the base branch whose run of the
same name succeeded, so the cancelled run counts as passing. Absent otherwise.

triggers.description: The triggers the event matched, so the triggers it requests tasks for; may be empty.

url.description: The pull request's page; the review's for a review, the check run's for a check.

description: A check run completed on a pull request's head commit, once per pull request.

id.description: A UUIDv5 of the message's name, so a retried publish keeps its id.

links.description: GitHub and Linear events carry one link to the event's page.

subject.description: A short line for listings, such as `owner/name#42`.

title: github.check_run.completed
